formats.pair_and_summary: one UTF-8 envelope JSON object per LF; payload is exact canonical JSON string
formats.journal: plain JSON per LF; Fraction fallback is {exact:canonical_string}

exact_types.dict: str(key), reference evaluation order, last collision wins, sort_keys=True

formats.summary_schema_application: Decode exact int/rat tags before applying result schema. Summary snapshot excludes finalization/outer STOP; journal and host report supply those.

canonical_chain.file_sha256: SHA256 of every physical byte including partial tail

rpc.RESERVE: validate global identity/order/budget; persist START_RESERVED; complete_before commits previous first
rpc.ENTER: reject after parent STOP, persist STARTED then IN_FLIGHT, reply permission
rpc.WRITE_RESERVE: parent reserves exact bytes before every unbuffered write
rpc.WRITE_ACK: coalesced into wrote_before on next RPC; never refunded/retried
rpc.COMPLETE: only after normal engine emit return and next proven commit boundary; axis/bundle last immediate
rpc.END: pair terminal report, never per-worker authority

stop.order: parent arrival order; physical exception time is not a total order
stop.after_parent_stop: no new ENTER grants; started trials drain cooperatively
stop.extra_inflight: P1 <= workers-1 additional trials; P2 <= inflight_cap-1 under rendezvous
stop.unknown: lost current ticket retains call and byte reservations; no refund/retry
stop.parent_crash: raw nonterminal reserved/started/inflight slots imply unknown; no rewriting crashed evidence
stop.multiple_notifications: FAIL and END may describe same trial; not separate quantum calls

budgets.log_accounting: retained state bytes + journal bytes; pwrite traffic measured separately
budgets.durability: unbuffered write/flush, no fsync claim for result/journal/state

receipt_join.scope: one global parent fake admission per bundle; no worker authority
receipt_join.summary: receipt.summary_sha and summary_chain bind summary.jsonl; receipt is final journal record only on success
receipt_join.admission_stop: external fake ledger STOP after host returns; missing STOP or STOP write error prevents acceptance
receipt_join.report_snapshot: summary contains coordinator snapshot before summary write; host report.output includes summary and final journal charges

costs.host_outer: entrypoint context, all approval/source checks, reserve/fsync, spawn/import, work/IPC/write, join, summary/receipt, outer Admission STOP; excludes fixture generation, readback and compression
costs.execution_outer: inside admission context; excludes outer admission STOP
costs.coordinator: Coordinator init to snapshot; excludes prior admission and finalization
costs.worker: pair before source check to after observer exit/close; process_cpu_ns includes pre-pair spawn startup
costs.startup: host_outer child rusage minus sum(pair.cpu_ns), labelled startup/unattributed; no zero assumption
costs.partitions: coarse and fine are separate exclusive partitions; never add to each other or outer
costs.observer: callback effects included in outer and residual; standalone exclusive observer overhead unknown
costs.wall: parent/worker wall overlap is never added

f01.committed_trace: trace_sha256 only completed after emit returned
f01.candidate_trace: candidate_trace_sha256 may include uncommitted current trial
f01.physical_prefix: can contain a full row whose flush failed; not logically completed

final_acceptance_requires: no log_errors or secondary STOP failures
verification.partial: verify all complete envelope lines; preserve partial trailing bytes; never interpret physical row count as committed trial count
